'''Blackie's''' was the name given by [[Blackie (junkyard owner)|Blackie]] and [[Cravel]], two thieves, to a junkyard in [[Vorrnti City]] that they took over shortly before [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]]. They used the yard as a front to fix up a derelict [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]] and use it to steal some [[Spice/Legends|spice]]. [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], an entrepreneur, visited them and thwarted their operation with the help of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Katarn Commandos]].
